payload.thirtySeconds: tnboles77 wins Week 2 Greywolf on net, beating Dan94 by three and the rest of the field by a comfortable pile. The weird part: Dan94 still owned the gross card, because his tee-to-green number was stupid good while tnboles77 won the SGT putting and short-game fight. Greywolf mostly turned into a putting-and-survival test, and a few dudes brought a shovel.
payload.latestTournamentTeaser: tnboles77 wins net while Dan94 absolutely nukes Greywolf tee to green
payload.stateOfLeague: This one confirms the top of the board is still a two-track league: some guys can torch the gross card, but the net trophy still rewards the cleaner whole-round package. It also reminds everybody that Greywolf will happily expose a weak short game and eat the lunch of anybody who starts spraying it into the weeds.
